collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — HUMOR AND ABSURDITY (HUM-01 to HUM-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Slapstick, silly noises, puns, pranks with permission, ridiculous coincidences, a little funny magic and animals being absurd. Nobody is the butt of the joke: everyone keeps their dignity, and the comedy needs no victim.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: A villager has spent all morning failing to open one coconut: let everyone have a turn, or declare it unopenable.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has been trying to open one particular coconut for most of the morning. (subject.He/she) has hit it with a rock, dropped it from a height and wedged it in the fork of a tree. It hasn't even cracked. Word has spread. A line of villagers has formed, each of them certain they know the trick.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (builder), a builder, hits it with a mallet. (fisher), a fisher, throws it at a rock. (elder), an elder, talks to it quietly for some time. Nothing. Then (child), a small child, picks it up to look at it, drops it on the soft sand, and it splits perfectly in two. A long silence. (child) drinks the milk. Nobody ever speaks of this again.

o2__fx.name: Outcome B
o2__fx.text: "This coconut," announces (subject), "cannot be opened." It is placed in a place of honor beside the fire, and for weeks people try their luck whenever they pass. Then one rainy morning it is found split open all by itself, with a green shoot poking out. (subject) plants it. It grows into a fine tree whose coconuts open perfectly normally, to everyone's slight disappointment.
